    | [match($pat; "g").string]
    | unique[]
    | "\($t)\t\($k)\t\(.)"' |
  sort |
  uniq -c |
  sort -rn

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# e2e-command-sweep.sh — drive the real PostToolUse entry point
# (`ethos hook audit-log`, the command plugin/hooks/audit-log.sh runs) and
# print the audit line it writes. Verification that the fix holds through
# the binary, not just in-process.
#
# Runs entirely inside a scratch repo under .tmp with a scratch HOME, so
# it cannot touch this repo's real session store.
set -euo pipefail

bin="$1"
work="$2"

rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -p "$work/repo/.punt-labs/ethos" "$work/home"
git -C "$work/repo" init -q
export HOME="$work/home"
export ETHOS_REPO_ROOT="$work/repo"

run() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | "$bin" hook audit-log
}

# 1. An address in prose quoted inside a command — the leader's case.
run '{"session_id":"sess-e2e","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"bd update ethos-6tuz -d \"recap mail to [redacted-email] is unsent\""}}'
# 2. A Co-Authored-By trailer inside a git commit heredoc.
run '{"session_id":"sess-e2e","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git commit -m \"fix: x\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude <[redacted-email]>\""}}'
# 3. The negative: an ordinary shell line must come back byte-identical.
run '{"session_id":"sess-e2e","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"make check 2>&1 | tee .tmp/check.log"}}'
# 4. Boundary: an address-shaped non-address is reduced with the rest.
run '{"session_id":"sess-e2e","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git clone [redacted-email]:punt-labs/vox.git"}}'
# 5. Missing dependency: no tool_input at all must not crash the hook.
run '{"session_id":"sess-e2e","tool_name":"Bash"}'

echo "--- audit lines as written to disk ---"
find "$work/repo/.punt-labs/ethos/sessions" -name 'audit-*.jsonl' -exec cat {} +

# installed-sweeps-command.sh — does the ethos binary on PATH (the one the

set -euo pipefail

rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -p "$work/repo/.punt-labs/ethos" "$work/home"
git -C "$work/repo" init -q
export HOME="$work/home"
export ETHOS_REPO_ROOT="$work/repo"

printf '%s\n' '{"session_id":"sess-installed","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git config user.email [redacted-email]"}}' |
  ethos hook audit-log

find "$work/repo/.punt-labs" -name '*.audit.jsonl' -exec cat {} +
